question:
**Select the correct spelling from the given options to replace the underlined word in the following sentence.**

The new policy will __supplant__ the old one and introduce stricter measures for workplace safety.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Supersede**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Supplant **means to replace or take the place of something or someone, often by force or through competition. (**उखाड़ना**)

 
 
• **Example**: *The new technology quickly supplants the outdated one, rendering it obsolete.*
 
 
 
• Marked option **Supersede **means to replace or take the place of something, especially when referring to a new thing or idea that is considered superior or more advanced than what it is replacing. (**अधिक्रमण करना**)
 
 
• **Example**: *The latest edition of the software supersedes the previous version.*
 
 
 
• Therefore, in the given sentence, "**supersede**" is the more fitting choice as it aligns with the idea of the new policy replacing the old one with an implication of improvement or advancement.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

**The correct spelling of other options with the meaning mentioned below-**

 
• Override-> Use one's authority to reject or cancel (a decision, view, etc.).
 
• Supersede-> To replace something older, less effective, or less important or official
 
• Succeed->To achieve something that you have been trying to do or get

Thus, the correct answer is **option 2**.
